clients.scenario: single-client open-terrain and bounded native-failure probe

open_terrain_running_follow.precondition: A disposable probe pre-staged the player and managed actor on a verified straight 18-tile outdoor corridor before measurement; no staging movement is counted as acceptance evidence.

native_no_progress_recovery.test_obstruction: The disposable client repeatedly applied setCanWalk(false), setUseless(true), and setSpeedMod(0.0) to the managed actor, without cancelling or replacing its native path. At blacklist expiry it restored setCanWalk(true), setUseless(false), and setSpeedMod(1.0).

staging.method: temporary localhost RCON teleportto commands moved players only

native_simulation_ownership_handoff.cleanup: Both players were returned to their pre-test positions; both Goblins resumed FOLLOW under their own player's native client authority.

furniture_detour.precondition: The loaded square was runtime-selected because it contained indoor seating and was not a valid free movement square. The owner alone was staged north of it while the managed actor began south of it; the actor remained inside the respawn-rejoin threshold.
furniture_detour.notes: One-second telemetry samples are intentionally too coarse to treat the largest inter-sample distance as a teleport test. Acceptance rests on the actor entering the free square west of the chair, never occupying the blocked chair square, then continuing north under native client authority without a FOLLOW_REJOIN event.

managed_door_access.authority: server changes door world state; current native client simulation owner performs movement
managed_door_access.adapter: ordinary ToggleDoorSilent plus full syncIsoObject; native toggleDoubleDoor/toggleGarageDoor for groups; no IsoPlayer actor cast
managed_door_access.safehouse_policy: no claim allows access; claimed square requires SafeHouse.playerAllowed(GoblinOwner); denial is unit-tested, not live-accepted
managed_door_access.notes: The final clean run loaded the safehouse-aware adapter and replicated access revision. It verifies the lock/open state on the server and both no-Storm clients plus resumed client-owned native movement. It does not claim save/reload or constructed IsoThumpable coverage.

proves: two ordinary no-Storm clients joined one server-side-Storm session
one distinct persistent Goblin spawned for each connected player
a following managed IsoZombie opened and crossed a door that was verified closed at start
a managed IsoZombie reached the runtime-selected radius-2 staging square for a structurally obstructed loaded target
the obstructed target was not mutated before an accepted interaction position
a managed IsoZombie physically followed a running owner on a straight open-terrain corridor without teleport after measurement began
a reversible no-progress obstruction produced exactly one native repath, one terminal blocked result, bounded blacklist expiry, and resumed physical movement without teleport

the installed engine transferred one managed IsoZombie from horse's client authority to unicorn's client authority as proximity changed, then reassigned it to horse after physical follow; no ownership field was written

a managed IsoZombie took a one-tile lateral route around a loaded indoor chair, crossed from its south side to its north side without occupying the chair square, remained under native client authority, and did not invoke respawn rejoin

the player-free door adapter opened and unlocked a locked ordinary door and all four locked garage segments, both ordinary clients observed the garage state, and the replicated access revision resumed native movement without FOLLOW_REJOIN
does_not_prove: live safehouse denial against another player's claim
